name: Inou Kokuan
source:
The family head of the Inou house, [url=/c39037]Hotori[/url]'s father, and the leader of the Sworn Blades, with the aim to free the Empire from the clutches of the Republic.
Over a year before the start of the story, he was captured during a rebellion attempt by the Republic, forcing the leadership role onto his daughter.
[spoiler]Unbeknowst to the Sworn Blades aiming to free him, he was mind controlled and turned into a loyal puppet.[/spoiler]
